tests.referenceText:
6.3 MapReduce Pipeline R1 · KB-1925 5. **归约阶段 \(Reducing\)**：Reducer 将不同 Mapper 的结果合并，生成最终输出并存储在本地。 Source: knowledge/5434-Big-Data-Computing-1.md · Big Data Computing · Part 1 · Lecture 4: Hadoop and MapReduce / part 6 Tutorial: Hadoop / 6.3 MapReduce Pipeline 6.5 MapReduce steps R2 · KB-1929 |阶段|课件原文|要点| |---|---|---| |判断适用性|Determine if the problem is parallelizable and solvable using MapReduce|两个条件：可并行 \+ 可用 MapReduce 解| |检查数据形态|Is the data Write Once Read Many \(WORM\)?|WORM 数据一次写入、多次读取，是并行的前提（无需锁）| |设计与实现|Design and implement Mapper class and Reducer class|两个函数| |配置、加载与运行|Configure the application \(job\) as to the number of mappers and reducers \(tasks\), input and output streams；Load the data；Launch the job and monitor|任务数可配置；数据加载；提交并监控
| Source: knowledge/5434-Big-Data-Computing-1.md · Big Data Computing · Part 1 · Lecture 4: Hadoop and MapReduce / part 6 Tutorial: Hadoop / 6.5 MapReduce steps 5.1.2 DIvide and Conquer R3 · KB-1799 MapReduce的最简形式：Split → Parser → Counter → 汇总 Source: knowledge/5434-Big-Data-Computing-1.md · Big Data Computing · Part 1 · Lecture 4: Hadoop and MapReduce / part 5 MapReduce Workflow and Programming / 5.1 Basic Workflow of MapReduce / 5.1.2 DIvide and Conquer 4.5.2 Divide and Conquer 分治法 R4 · KB-1788 1. **split 与 merge 成对出现：**每条边上都有 **split / merge**（split 用粉色箭头向下，merge 用蓝色箭头向上），在后面的内容中把这一页的两条边正式命名为 **Partition**（对应 split）与 **Combine**（对应 merge）。 Source: knowledge/5434-Big-Data-Computing-1.md · Big Data Computing · Part 1 · Lecture 4: Hadoop and MapReduce / part 4 MapReduce Technical Ideas / 4.5 For Memory and Storage Issues / 4.5.2 Divide and Conquer 分治法
